newsitem.title: USA: Tyco, Amer. Standard halted - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Tyco, Amer. Standard halted - NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said trading in shares of American Standard Cos Inc and Tyco International Ltd was halted news pending.

A Tyco spokesman said its shares where halted because American Standard is expected to issue a statement shortly -- a move likely related to Tyco's $50 per share cash and stock offer for American Standard, which was first made in a letter to American Standard early last month.
The Tyco spokesman said he did not know the contents of the American Standard statement and said Tyco may issue a statement after American Standard's news release.
An American Standard spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
American Standard shares finished Friday's NYSE session at 40-1/2, while Tyco ended the day at 54-5/8.
According to the Wall Street Journal, the cash and stock deal would be worth about $4 billion, plus assumption of debt.
